name: ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor is the free website foundation of the Vendix ecosystem. It combines essential Elementor widgets with centralized business information and practical tools for search visibility, structured data, icons and media management.

Instead of installing a separate plugin for every small website requirement, Site Utilities provides one focused workspace for the features most Elementor websites need every day.

✨ Everything included in Free

  • Guided Setup for a business, news or store site, with one-click undo.
  • 29 Elementor widgets, including three news widgets for news and magazine pages.
  • Global Company Information, reused anywhere through shortcodes and Elementor Dynamic Tags.
  • Design System with brand colors and body and heading fonts for ARN widgets and layouts, or the whole site; Google fonts are downloaded once and served from the site itself.
  • ARN Smart Icon Manager with 3,800 unique, font-free icons.
  • SEO & Visibility Engine with metadata, a social sharing preview, Schema, XML sitemaps and content readiness analysis.
  • Header & Footer Builder with display rules and live preview; it works with the Vendix theme.
  • AI Media Intelligence with review-first suggestions, through Settings → ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key stored encrypted, model, prices, usage and monthly limits).
  • Smart Features: Search & Replace, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Disable Comments, Site Banner and Quick Menu.
  • WooCommerce Tools: Store Type and Product Identifiers & Cost with tax-aware profit-margin tracking.
  • Responsive, RTL/LTR and accessibility-aware output, with modular loading so optional systems and large icon packs load only when required.
  • No license key and no private updater. Free updates use the normal WordPress repository workflow.

🧭 Guided Setup

ARN Utilities → Setup opens once after the first activation and sets up a site in about five minutes. The Vendix theme’s welcome page leads to it too.

  • Pick Business, News & Magazine or Online Store; the setup turns on the features that kind of site needs. Advanced levels and a fully custom setup are part of Vendix Pro.
  • Choose one of six color palettes and four font pairs (or keep your current colors), fill in your company details once, and optionally add sample pages, a Main menu and a simple header and footer. For an online store, WooCommerce is installed and activated only when you click.
  • Undo setup brings your earlier settings back and moves the pages and layouts the setup made to the Trash. Your posts, products, orders, existing pages and menus are never touched.

🧩 29 Elementor widgets

All widgets appear inside the ARN Smart Site Utilities category in Elementor. New widgets come with a short sample story and drawings, so a page looks finished before you change the text.

  • Headings and text: Advanced Heading, Icon Heading, List Block, Smart Text Editor.
  • Hero and calls to action: Hero Slider, Button, CTA, Counter, Feature Block, Process / Timeline, Pricing Table.
  • People and trust: Testimonials, Team Members, Logo Carousel.
  • Company and contact: Company Information, Contact Cards, Get in Touch, Business Hours.
  • Site parts: Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools, Site Logo, Breadcrumbs.
  • Content and media: Post / Content Grid, FAQ, Responsive Image.
  • News widgets (Smart Features → News Widgets, off by default): Section Header, News Blocks, News Ticker.

The four site widgets — Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools and Site Logo — work in any theme or Elementor layout and do not need the plugin’s own Header & Footer Builder. What each widget does is listed in the FAQ.

🧱 Header & Footer Builder

Build site headers and footers under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer without a page builder template.

  • Rows and columns with logo, menu, mobile menu, search, button, text, contact, social, language, account, cart, wishlist, copyright, image, HTML, spacer and divider elements.
  • Display rules for the whole site, the front page, search results, the 404 page, single content or archives, with exclusions; sticky and transparent headers, a mobile panel and live preview.
  • Works with classic and block themes (also on Elementor Full Width pages), with blank page templates such as Elementor Canvas, and with the Vendix theme’s own header and footer places.
  • Keyboard and screen reader friendly: the mobile panel and the search layer keep the focus inside while open, and Escape closes an open sub-menu.

🏢 Company Information, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags

Enter website, company, contact, legal and social data once under ARN Utilities → Company Data and reuse it everywhere: in Site Utilities widgets, through shortcodes in any WordPress or Elementor content, and through Elementor Dynamic Tags in native Elementor widgets.

Official information is often repeated in privacy policies, terms of use, distance-sales agreements, refund policies, contact pages and footers. With shortcodes, an address, phone number or legal detail is updated in one field instead of on dozens of pages:

[arnsmesu_company_legal_name], registered under [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry], operates from [arnsmesu_company_address]. Contact: [arnsmesu_company_phone].

The full list of fields, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags is in the FAQ.

🎨 ARN Smart Icon Manager

  • 3,800 unique, font-free SVG-mask icons in exactly two sets, Default Icons (1,181) and Interface Essentials (2,994), that inherit the Elementor color and scale cleanly at any size.
  • Category and icon search, a personal My Icons selection, and whole categories when required; large icon styles load by pack instead of the complete library on every page.
  • Disabling a category never breaks icons already saved in Elementor content. Elementor’s own and Font Awesome libraries remain available.

📈 SEO & Visibility Engine

The Visibility Engine is disabled until an administrator enables it. It can work as a complete visibility layer, or keep only its analyzer when another supported SEO plugin controls public metadata.

  • SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, robots, Open Graph and X cards, with a live social sharing preview.
  • Analysis of the content that is actually rendered (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor and shortcodes): headings, images and alt text, links, length and a page language check, with a readiness score and recommendations.
  • Connected JSON-LD Schema and a controlled XML sitemap.

These tools improve content structure and machine understanding; they do not promise rankings or AI citations. The details are in the FAQ.

🤖 AI Media Intelligence

AI Media is optional and disabled by default. It follows a preview-first workflow so an administrator remains in control.

  • Filename, title, slug and alt-text suggestions, previewed before anything is applied, for one item or in batches.
  • Filename changes keep WordPress metadata and content references in sync; every change is recorded and can be restored.
  • Optional alt text for newly uploaded images.

AI requests go through Settings → ARN Free AI, the AI connection shared by ARN Free plugins: WordPress AI (the provider connected under Settings → Connectors on WordPress 7.0+, no API key stored), or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot AI), xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint, with the model you choose. Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

When ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) is active and manages media AI on the site, AI Media leaves media suggestions and automatic alt text to WebPix and shows a link to it instead.

🧰 Smart Features

Site-wide utilities, each turned on or off under ARN Utilities → Smart Features:

  • Admin Notes on the dashboard, personal or shared.
  • Draft Preview Links that expire after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days and can be revoked.
  • Search & Replace for the database with preview, undo of the last 5 runs, old domain scan and cache purge.
  • Disable Comments site-wide, without ever deleting existing comments.
  • Site Banner, News Widgets and the Quick Menu of admin shortcuts to filtered lists.

🛒 WooCommerce Tools

Available when WooCommerce is active; both tools are optional and disabled by default.

  • Store Type declares the store Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed, and the product editor adjusts to match. Existing products are never changed automatically.
  • Product Identifiers & Cost adds MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP, Manufacturer, Supplier, Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs, with live, tax-aware profit-margin tracking. Cost fields are never shown to customers.

⚙️ Settings and data lifecycle

  • Optional modules remain inactive until enabled, and deactivation never deletes settings, authored content or company information.
  • Data is removed only when the administrator enables the uninstall option and then deletes the plugin; Vendix Pro data and Elementor templates are not removed. Multisite-aware.

⭐ Upgrade to ARN Smart Vendix Pro

ARN Smart Vendix is the professional Elementor framework for larger production websites. It includes the complete Free foundation and adds:

  • A much larger widget collection: more hero designs, sliders, carousels, tabs, tickers, countdowns, pricing and comparison tables, modals, hotspots and before/after images, and more layouts and options for the Free widgets.
  • The full newspaper set, the full Design System with the Elementor Kit, and advanced and custom levels in the guided setup.
  • Form Guard, per content-type Disable Comments, a Store Type scan-and-convert tool and other site tools.
  • AEO / GEO / AIO analysis, E-E-A-T evidence checks and the Site Report.
  • ARN Smart license management, private Pro updates and priority support.

Site Utilities remains independently installable and usable without an ARN Smart Vendix Pro license.

Learn more: Explore ARN Smart Vendix

🔗 Other ARN Smart Products

ARN Smart develops focused WordPress products that can be used independently or together:

  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer / ARN Smart WebPix — local image optimization in Free; advanced discovery, coverage, queues, delivery, and diagnostics in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Content Toolkit / ARN Smart Clonex — controlled draft preparation in Free; structured duplication, datasets, bulk production, and builder-aware workflows in Pro.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager / ARN Smart Linkix — short links, redirects, QR codes, and local analytics in Free; custom permalinks, Smart App Links, branded QR, analytics, and maintenance in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent / ARN Smart Visioix — visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics, and contact actions in Free; connected visitor and website intelligence in Pro.

Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

AI Media (ARN Free AI). This plugin does not contact any ARN server. AI features are off until a site administrator sets them up under Settings > ARN Free AI.

When an administrator chooses a provider and enters their own API key, the plugin sends the text (and, for media features, the selected image) needed for the requested task to that provider only, at the moment the task runs. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

Requests are sent only while Media Intelligence is enabled: when an administrator clicks AI Preview or Generate Selected Previews, or when automatic alt text (off by default) runs for a newly uploaded image. Sent data: the image (a copy of at most 4 MB, preferably a smaller size made by WordPress; SVG files are not sent) and its context: site name and tagline, file name, file type, title, slug, current alt text, caption, a short description, the parent post title, the titles and short excerpts of up to three posts that use the file, and the site language. The “Test connection” (a fixed test prompt, no site content) and “Load models” (the provider’s model list) buttons under Settings > ARN Free AI also contact the chosen provider when an administrator clicks them. Nothing is sent while AI is not set up, or while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI on the site.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, requests go through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

The bundled ARN Free AI module keeps its settings in the arn_free_ai_settings option and daily AI usage totals (no prompts, answers or keys) in the {prefix}arn_free_ai_usage database table.

Design System Google fonts. Only when an administrator chooses a Google font as the body or heading font under ARN Utilities > Design System and saves: the site’s server downloads that font once, the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and the WOFF2 font files it lists from fonts.gstatic.com (Latin, Latin Extended and Arabic, the weights the Design System uses). The request carries the font family and weights only; no visitor or site data is sent. The files are stored in wp-content/uploads/arnsmesu-fonts and served from the site itself, so visitors’ browsers never connect to Google. The font list comes from Elementor.

  • Google Fonts: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

Search & Replace. Only when an administrator uses these tools:

  • “Find old addresses” sends an HTTP HEAD request to at most 5 earlier site addresses found in the database, using one sample file address on each, to see whether the old address still answers. No site data is sent.
  • After a run or an undo, the plugin requests the site’s own home page once to detect a server or CDN page cache.

Guided Setup. Only when an administrator clicks “Install & activate” on the setup’s Plugins step of an online store: WordPress’s own plugin installer asks WordPress.org for WooCommerce’s download address and downloads it from there, as it does under Plugins → Add New. No other setup step uses an external service.

  • WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

The Header & Footer Builder, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links and Social Sharing Preview do not use external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor.
  2. Make sure Elementor is active.
  3. Follow the guided setup under ARN Utilities → Setup (it opens once after activation), or open ARN Utilities → Company Data and enter the reusable organization details.
  4. Open Elementor and find the widgets under ARN Smart Site Utilities.
  5. Enable AI Media or SEO & Visibility only when the website needs those modules.
sections.faq:
Does the Free version require a license key?

No. Site Utilities has no license gate and no private-update client.

Can the four header widgets be used without a Vendix header template?

Yes. Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools and Site Logo are normal Elementor widgets. They can be placed in theme templates, Elementor templates, page content or any compatible layout.

Why should company information use shortcodes or Dynamic Tags?

They prevent the same legal, contact and organization information from being manually repeated across many pages. One update can refresh every connected location.

Will changing a media filename break its existing use?

The media transaction updates supported WordPress and Elementor references and records the previous state. Administrators can review changes first and restore the original state when necessary.

Does the plugin replace my current SEO plugin automatically?

No. The Visibility Engine is opt-in and checks for another active SEO system before taking ownership of public metadata, Schema or sitemap output.

Are AI features automatic?

No. AI Media is disabled by default, and it is designed around review-first suggestions. When enabled, it uses the AI connection set up under Settings → ARN Free AI: WordPress AI (a provider connected under Settings → Connectors) or a provider you configure with your own API key and model. Automatic alt text for new uploads runs only when you turn it on and AI is set up.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

By default your settings and content are kept. With “Delete all Site Utilities data when the plugin is permanently uninstalled” on (ARN Utilities → Settings), Site Utilities settings, logs, analysis metadata, Header & Footer layouts and admin notes are removed; on Multisite each site follows its own choice. The shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of those sites are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them.

Is my product cost or margin data ever shown to customers?

No. Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs are internal-only by design — there is no setting that puts them on the frontend or in structured data, unlike the other Product Identifiers fields.

Does Product Identifiers create a duplicate barcode field?

Not when your WooCommerce version already has a native Global Unique ID field (WooCommerce 8.0+). GTIN reuses that field instead of creating a second one, and simply adds the extra list column, Quick Edit and structured-data support around it.

What does each widget do?

  1. ARN Advanced Heading — Builds layered headings with upper text, main text, highlighted words, lower text, multiple layout presets, decorative lines, responsive alignment, optional CTA and load/scroll highlight animation.
  2. ARN Breadcrumbs — Shows the automatic trail of the page (page hierarchy or the post’s categories) in the Minimal or Rounded Trail layout; the BreadcrumbList schema follows the trail shown.
  3. ARN Business Hours — Displays opening hours in structured rows, supports centralized company hours, open/closed presentation, responsive styling and an optional action button.
  4. ARN Button — Creates flexible CTA buttons with icons, responsive sizing, solid/outline/gradient visual styles, hover motion and optional animated backgrounds.
  5. ARN Company Information — Creates sortable company-data rows with selectable fields, custom labels, automatic links, icons and list, grid or inline layouts.
  6. ARN Contact Cards — Branch and contact cards with phone, email, address, working hours, a directions link and a button, in the Branch Cards or Compact Rows layout.
  7. ARN Counter — Animated or static numbers with prefix, suffix, decimals and a thousands separator, starting when they come into view.
  8. ARN CTA — A call-to-action box with a badge, title, text and one or two buttons on a solid or gradient background.
  9. ARN FAQ — Builds accessible accordion FAQs with multiple-open mode, open/close all control, URL hashes, keyboard navigation, configurable animation and optional FAQ Schema.
  10. ARN Feature Block — Creates service, benefit, process and feature cards with icons or images, numbers, descriptions, links, buttons, multiple layouts, equal heights and responsive columns.
  11. ARN Get in Touch — Displays address, phone, email, WhatsApp, map and social channels using centralized or custom values, with automatic links and detailed responsive styling.
  12. ARN Header Search — Adds a compact website search field or search-icon presentation suitable for Elementor headers and other page areas.
  13. ARN Header Tools — Adds reusable account, wishlist and WooCommerce cart actions with optional cart count. It can be placed in any Elementor layout.
  14. ARN Hero Slider — Full-width slides with desktop and mobile images, title, subtitle, description, up to three buttons, an overlay, autoplay, fade or slide transitions, arrows and dots.
  15. ARN Icon Heading — Combines an icon or image with a title for compact service labels, feature headings and navigation-style content.
  16. ARN List Block — Builds structured icon, image or numbered lists with titles, descriptions, links, bulk entry support, responsive layouts and precise marker alignment.
  17. ARN Logo Carousel — An endless logo strip or a static grid with speed, pause on hover and focus, visible logo count and grayscale styles.
  18. ARN Navigation Menu — Displays a selected WordPress menu or your own list of custom links, with Header and Inner menu types, 10 item styles, active page highlighting, border and line colors and thickness for normal, hover and active states, dropdown support, responsive collapse controls, mobile panel behavior and keyboard-friendly interaction.
  19. ARN Post / Content Grid — The latest posts, pages or other content as Clean Cards or a Horizontal List, with excerpt, topic label, “Read more” text and an empty-state message.
  20. ARN Pricing Table — Plans with price, currency, features, a featured plan badge and a button, in the Clean Split or Featured Plan design.
  21. ARN Process / Timeline — Steps as Horizontal Steps or a Vertical Timeline, with marker content and shape settings and a connecting line.
  22. ARN Responsive Image — Uses separate desktop, tablet and mobile images with alt text, links, lazy/eager loading, fixed or natural visual slots, object fit, alignment, offsets, transforms and responsive visibility.
  23. ARN Site Logo — Displays the centralized company logo, the WordPress custom logo or a custom image with responsive sizing and linking controls.
  24. ARN Smart Text Editor — Adds rich text with an Add Shortcode selector so centralized company and legal values can be inserted directly into long-form content.
  25. ARN Team Members — Team cards with photo, role, short text and email, LinkedIn and profile links, in the Classic Cards or Compact List layout.
  26. ARN Testimonials — Customer quotes in a grid with name, role, photo, company logo, star rating and source link.
  27. ARN Section Header (news widget) — The title bar of a news section in four styles, with a subtitle and a “More” link.
  28. ARN News Blocks (news widget) — The latest posts, or the posts of chosen categories, in three newspaper layouts (lead beside a list, lead on top with a grid below, a grid of equal items), with an optional header and a link at the end.
  29. ARN News Ticker (news widget) — A breaking news band with a label and the latest headlines scrolling in a loop, with a pause button; with reduced motion it shows one headline at a time with arrows.

Which company fields, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags are available?

Fields: site name, company email and site URL; full and short company name, company logo, address, two phone numbers, WhatsApp number, working hours and map URL; legal company name, tax office and tax number, trade registry number, MERSIS or company registry ID and chamber registration number; Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and TikTok.

Common shortcodes

  • [arnsmesu_site_name] — Website name
  • [arnsmesu_site_mail] — Company email
  • [arnsmesu_site_link] — Website URL
  • [arnsmesu_company_name] — Full company name
  • [arnsmesu_company_name_short] — Short company name
  • [arnsmesu_company_logo] — Company logo
  • [arnsmesu_company_address] — Company address
  • [arnsmesu_company_phone] — One or two linked phone numbers
  • [arnsmesu_company_whatsapp] — Linked WhatsApp number
  • [arnsmesu_company_hours] — Working hours
  • [arnsmesu_company_map] — Map link
  • [arnsmesu_company_legal_name] — Registered legal name
  • [arnsmesu_company_tax] — Tax office and tax number
  • [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry] — Trade registry number
  • [arnsmesu_company_mersis] — MERSIS or company registry ID
  • [arnsmesu_company_chamber] — Chamber registration number
  • [arnsmesu_company_social network="linkedin"] — Selected social profile
  • [arnsmesu_current_date] — Current date using the WordPress timezone and date format
  • [arnsmesu_company field="current_year"] — Current year using the WordPress timezone

Flexible shortcodes

  • [arnsmesu_company_value field="company_name" fallback="Company"] returns any supported field with an optional fallback.
  • [arnsmesu_company field="company_address" link="auto" multiline="yes"] controls fallback, linking, label, multiline output and link target.
  • [arnsmesu_company_link type="whatsapp" label="Contact us"] creates phone, email, WhatsApp, map, website or social links.

Elementor Dynamic Tags: Company Value for text controls, Company Dynamic Link for phone, email, WhatsApp, map, website and social URLs, and Company Logo for image and media controls, each with an optional fallback value.

Changing a saved value updates every shortcode, Dynamic Tag and connected Site Utilities widget that uses it.

What does the SEO & Visibility Engine output and check?

Search and social metadata: custom SEO title and meta description per page or post, canonical URL and robots directives, focus phrase, supporting phrases and search-intent planning fields, Open Graph and X/Twitter card metadata, a default social image with per-page overrides, and automatic suppression of duplicate public output when another SEO system is active.

Rendered-content analysis: one resolved visible content source to prevent duplicate counting; word, paragraph and sentence diagnostics; H1 and heading-hierarchy checks; image and missing-alt checks; internal and external link checks; lists, tables and topic detection; a page language check (site language, Polylang or WPML) so phrases are matched in the right writing system; a page-level readiness score with actionable recommendations.

Connected JSON-LD Schema: WebSite; Organization, Corporation or LocalBusiness; WebPage, AboutPage, ContactPage and CollectionPage; Article and BlogPosting; Service and Product; BreadcrumbList; FAQPage through the FAQ widget; connected publisher, image and page relationships.

Controlled XML sitemap: selected post types and taxonomies, optional author archives, specific content IDs excluded and a configurable maximum of URLs per sitemap part. Noindex content, builder templates, password-protected items and unsuitable content are excluded automatically.

How does AI Media work?

  • One AI Media page with General, Media Library and AI Connection tabs.
  • Filter all media, images with missing alt text, generic filenames or items previously changed by Site Utilities.
  • Preview every proposed value and choose which fields are changed for each media item; generate and apply selected items in batches; preview controlled word replacements.
  • Physical filename changes stay synchronized with WordPress metadata and stored content references; every change is recorded as a reversible transaction that restores the original filename, title, slug and alt text.
  • Missing alt text can be prepared for newly uploaded images; decorative images are skipped and low-confidence automatic suggestions go to review.

Until AI is set up under Settings → ARN Free AI, suggestions come from the file name and context without AI and new uploads get no automatic alt text. When the provider chosen for images cannot read images, the suggestion is made from the context only, marked as a guess and never saved automatically. API keys can also be supplied through wp-config.php constants (ARN_FREE_AI_<PROVIDER>_KEY, for example ARN_FREE_AI_OPENAI_KEY). The AI Connection tab shows whether AI is set up and this month’s AI use of the plugin.

What exactly do the Smart Features do?

Admin Notes: a dashboard box for notes with colors, personal or shared visibility, and mark-as-done.

Draft Preview Links: share a draft with people who have no account through a secret link that expires after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days, and can be revoked. Preview pages are marked “Draft preview”, are not indexed or cached, and do not print the plugin’s SEO or Schema output.

Search & Replace: search and replace text or old addresses in the database, with a preview of the affected rows before anything changes; undo any of the last 5 runs; an old domain scan finds earlier site addresses still stored in the database; supported page caches are purged after a run. Administrators only; on Multisite, Super Admins only.

Disable Comments: one switch stops new comments and pingbacks everywhere on the site. Optionally hide the Comments menu item and the admin bar comment bubble (with a safe redirect if the direct URL is visited) and remove comment widgets from the Dashboard. Existing comments are never deleted, hidden or moderated. Per content-type control is a Vendix Pro feature.

Site Banner: one image banner with alt text and a link (new tab, sponsored or nofollow), placed anywhere with the [arnsmesu_banner] shortcode.

News Widgets: one switch adds ARN Section Header, ARN News Blocks and ARN News Ticker to Elementor. While it is off, no news widget is offered and no news style sheet loads.

Quick Menu: custom admin menu shortcuts to filtered product or post lists, with no code and no limit on the number of links. Filter by post type, post status, taxonomy/term, stock status, product type or a custom query string; group links under one custom parent menu with its own icon and position, or give a link its own top-level menu; set the required capability per link and whether it opens in a new tab. Links are rebuilt from the site’s own address plus allowlisted query parameters every time they render, so nothing breaks if the site moves.

How do Store Type and Product Identifiers work?

Store Type

  • Physical mode removes the Virtual/Downloadable checkboxes from the editor and enforces the setting on every save using WooCommerce’s own CRUD methods.
  • Virtual and Digital modes pre-check the right boxes for brand-new products only — existing products are never changed automatically.
  • Independently restrict which product types (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External/Affiliate) can be selected, regardless of store mode.
  • Optional toggle to stop saving variation price-cache meta that WooCommerce regenerates on demand, reducing database bloat on large catalogs.
  • A one-click scan-and-convert tool for existing products is a Vendix Pro feature.

Product Identifiers & Cost

  • Eight independent fields: MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP/Customs Tariff Number, Manufacturer, Supplier, Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs.
  • Every field is configured on its own — admin field, variation support, list column, Quick Edit support, frontend display and Schema.org output are all separate toggles.
  • A live, unsaved profit-margin estimate appears on the product edit screen as you type, using an estimated tax rate for the product’s tax class. The admin product list shows the exact, tax-aware margin, computed with WooCommerce’s own pricing logic from the real selling price.
  • Structured data output is automatically skipped when a dedicated SEO plugin (Yoast, RankMath, SEOPress, AIOSEO, The SEO Framework) is active, avoiding duplicate Product schema.

It opens once after the first activation, turns on the features that kind of site needs, applies one of six color palettes and four font choices (or keeps your current colors), fills in your company details and can add sample pages, a Main menu and a simple header and footer.
  • Added: For an online store the guided setup installs and activates WooCommerce only when you click. Your settings are saved first: Undo setup brings them back and moves the pages and layouts the setup made to the Trash, and your posts, products, orders and existing pages are never touched.
  • Added: 11 Elementor widgets in the ARN Smart Site Utilities category. New widgets start with sample text and drawings, and their styles and scripts load only on pages that use them. Eight of them build page sections: Hero Slider (full-width slides with desktop and mobile images and up to three buttons), CTA, Counter (animated numbers that start when they come into view), Testimonials, Logo Carousel (an endless logo strip or a static grid), Team Members, Pricing Table and Contact Cards (branch cards with phone, email, address, hours and a directions link).
  • Added: The other three new widgets: Process / Timeline (horizontal steps or a vertical timeline with a connecting line), Post / Content Grid (the latest posts, pages or other content as cards or a list) and Breadcrumbs (the automatic page trail, with BreadcrumbList structured data that follows it; on store pages it shows WooCommerce’s own trail of the shop, product categories and products).
  • Added: 3 news widgets for news and magazine pages: Section Header (the title bar of a news section in four styles, with a “More” link), News Blocks (the latest posts, or the posts of chosen categories, in three newspaper layouts) and News Ticker (a breaking news band with a pause button; with reduced motion it shows one headline at a time). Turn them on under ARN Utilities → Smart Features → News Widgets; they are off by default, and while they are off no news style sheet loads.
  • Added: Design System under ARN Utilities → Design System: eleven brand colors (primary, secondary, accent, heading, text, link, link hover, muted, border, light and dark backgrounds) and one body and one heading font, applied to ARN widgets and Header & Footer layouts or to the entire site. A Google font you choose is downloaded once and served from your own site, so visitors never connect to Google. The Vendix theme uses these colors in its block editor palette.
  • Added: Header & Footer Builder under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer, without a page builder template: rows and columns with logo, menu, mobile menu, search, button, text, contact, social, language, account, cart (its item count stays up to date on cached pages too), wishlist, copyright, image, HTML, spacer and divider elements, sticky and transparent headers, a mobile side panel, live preview and drafts.
  • Added: Header & Footer layouts work with classic themes, with block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Five (also on pages with the Elementor Full Width template), with blank templates such as Elementor Canvas and with the Vendix theme, where they take the theme’s own header and footer places. The mobile panel and the search layer keep the keyboard focus inside while open, Escape closes an open sub-menu, and menu items with a sub-menu announce it to screen readers.
  • Added: Header & Footer display rules for the whole site, the front page, search results, the 404 page, single content or archives, with exclusions. Single pages, posts, categories and tags are picked from two search fields that find them as you type.
  • Added: Smart Features under ARN Utilities → Smart Features, each turned on by itself: Admin Notes on the dashboard (colors, personal or shared, mark as done); Draft Preview Links, which show a draft to people without an account through a secret link that ends after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days or when you revoke it; and Search & Replace for the database with a preview of the rows it changes, undo of the last 5 runs, a scan for old site addresses and a page cache purge (administrators only).
  • Added: More Smart Features: Disable Comments, which stops new comments site-wide without deleting existing ones; Quick Menu, admin menu shortcuts to filtered post and product lists with no limit on the number of links; and Site Banner, one image banner with a link, placed with the [arnsmesu_banner] shortcode.
  • Added: WooCommerce tools under ARN Utilities → WooCommerce, both off by default. Store Type sets the store to Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed and adjusts the product editor: Physical removes the Virtual and Downloadable boxes and keeps them off on every save, Virtual and Digital tick them for new products only, and the product types on offer can be limited.
  • Added: Product Identifiers & Cost, the second WooCommerce tool, adds eight product fields (MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP, Manufacturer, Supplier, Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs), each configured on its own. GTIN uses WooCommerce’s own Global Unique ID field, the cost fields are never shown to customers, and the product list shows a tax-aware profit margin.
  • Added: Settings → ARN Free AI, the AI connection shared by ARN Free plugins. Choose WordPress AI (the provider connected under Settings → Connectors on WordPress 7.0 and later) or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot AI), xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint, with the model you pick.
  • Added: On Settings → ARN Free AI, keys are stored encrypted and never shown again, and each provider has Load models, Test connection and Remove saved key. The screen shows token use and cost by month, feature and provider, with optional prices and a monthly limit that pauses AI requests.
  • Added: In the SEO & Visibility Engine, a live social sharing preview card in the SEO box of each page, a page language check in the page analysis (site language, Polylang or WPML) so phrases are matched in the right writing system, and SoftwareApplication as a selectable Schema type for product and plugin pages.
  • Added: ARN Navigation Menu has Header and Inner menu types, 10 item styles, your own list of custom links with active page highlighting, and border and line colors and thickness for the normal, hover and active states. Existing menu settings keep working.
  • Added: A “Title HTML Tag” setting (H1–H6, DIV, P or SPAN) for the item titles of ARN Feature Block and ARN List Block, so titles can be real headings in the page outline. The default stays DIV, so existing pages do not change.
  • Added: While ARN Smart Vendix runs a part of this plugin (Company Data, Design System, Smart Features, the WooCommerce tools or AI Media), that part’s screen says so at the top and links to the matching Vendix screen. The settings stay editable and apply again once Vendix is turned off; meanwhile the Design System card of the dashboard says “Managed by Vendix”.
  • Changed: Your AI settings and API keys move to Settings → ARN Free AI by themselves the first time an administrator opens a wp-admin page, and the old plain-text keys are removed from this plugin’s settings. If no AI provider was chosen before the update, “Automatically prepare missing alt text” is turned off once, so new uploads do not start going to an AI provider on their own.
  • Changed: AI Media is one page with General, Media Library and AI Connection tabs; the AI Connection tab shows whether AI is set up and this month’s AI use of the plugin. A busy AI answer (HTTP 429, 500, 502, 503 or 504) is retried twice after a short wait before a plain-language message replaces the provider’s raw error.
  • Changed: AI Media asks the AI for alt text of one short sentence of at most 125 characters that says what the image shows. Alt text longer than 150 characters gets a warning, and when the image could not be sent to the AI (the provider or model cannot read images), the alt text is marked as a guess from the file name and context; neither is ever saved automatically.
  • Changed: When ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) is active and manages media AI on the site, AI Media leaves media suggestions and automatic alt text to WebPix and links to it. Renaming a media file also renames the WebP and AVIF copies WebPix made (and updates WebPix’s file index) and the ones LiteSpeed Cache keeps next to the image, so the copies keep being served without a new conversion, and undoing the rename moves them back.
  • Changed: The company email under ARN Utilities → Company Data is empty by default instead of the WordPress admin email, so the admin address is not published by accident. While it is empty, [arnsmesu_site_mail], ARN Company Information, Header & Footer and the structured data show no email address; an email you saved before stays as it is. ARN Company Information now labels it “Company Email” instead of “Site Email”.
  • Changed: The icon library ships as one file per category, so the plugin has about 290 files instead of about 3,800 and installs and updates unpack faster. Icons on pages carry their own drawing and need no extra request, and the Elementor editor no longer preloads the icon stylesheets: Elementor loads them when the icon picker opens. Icons look the same.
  • Changed: ARN icons take their shape only from the small shared icon stylesheet, no longer also from the icon pack stylesheets. Pages that a page cache plugin or a CDN kept from an older version can show empty spaces instead of icons until that cache is cleared; pages cached after the update are not affected.
  • Changed: With the SEO & Visibility Engine on, search results and 404 pages always get noindex, whatever the default robots setting says, so they are never indexed.
  • Changed: The dashboard shows the real number of widgets and the Design System status in place of the WordPress Updates card.
  • Changed: With ARN Smart Vendix (Pro) 2.0.0 active, pages built with this plugin keep working and nothing runs twice: Vendix draws this plugin’s widgets with the same look and runs the SEO output (one set of tags per page), the design colors and fonts, the company shortcodes and Dynamic Tags, Store Type, Product Identifiers and AI Media. Where Vendix draws its own header or footer, this plugin does not print a second one.
  • Changed: Quick Menu, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Disable Comments and the Site Banner move to ARN Smart Vendix only when its license includes Banners. Otherwise this plugin keeps running them while it is active, and Vendix runs them once this plugin is deactivated.
  • Fixed: Saving a page in Elementor no longer shows “Server Error”. The page analysis that runs after a save printed Elementor’s page CSS into the save reply; the page was saved, but the editor could not read the reply.
  • Fixed: The page analysis reads the same rendered content a visitor sees, also when a page is saved from wp-admin, instead of falling back to the raw post content. A skipped heading level no longer zeroes the heading score; a page with real subheadings gets partial credit.
  • Fixed: Automatic meta descriptions no longer start with breadcrumb text such as “Home / Site Name” on builder pages, and words in them are no longer glued together.
  • Fixed: With the SEO & Visibility Engine on, pages follow “Discourage search engines” under Settings → Reading again, and the plugin’s robots values join the one robots tag of WordPress instead of printing a second tag.
  • Fixed: The BreadcrumbList structured data is left out on pages that show no breadcrumb trail, and ARN FAQ prints a single FAQPage schema per page. When the “Open all” and “Close all” texts of ARN FAQ are left empty, it shows the translated defaults.
  • Fixed: ARN Feature Block: with “Equal height cards” on, the button sits at the bottom of every card in all layouts, so buttons line up across a row even when the descriptions differ in length. A row with fewer features than columns shares the full width, a one-column layout stays one column on tablets and phones, the numbers of the numbered layouts count correctly, and a button without its own alignment follows the content alignment.
  • Fixed: ARN Button and ARN Advanced Heading use the site and theme accent colors when their color fields are left empty.
  • Fixed: ARN Get in Touch shows brand icons for social links in the icons layout, and ARN Header Tools never prints an empty wishlist or compare link.
  • Fixed: ARN Advanced Heading and ARN Navigation Menu show a short notice in the Elementor editor instead of an empty area when something is missing (a button without text, a site without a WordPress menu, or Custom Links without a link); visitors see nothing.
  • Fixed: The mobile menu toggle of ARN Navigation Menu and the icon-only social links of ARN Get in Touch have a touch target of at least 44 px.
  • Fixed: The “Dropdown Background” color of ARN Navigation Menu applies to sub-menus and to the mobile panel.
  • Fixed: The menu list of ARN Navigation Menu and of Header & Footer layouts keeps the same HTML ID on every page view, also when a page shows the same menu twice, so custom CSS or scripts that use the ID keep working.
  • Fixed: A Header & Footer sub-menu near the end of the menu row opens towards the inside instead of leaving the window, so the page no longer scrolls sideways and the whole sub-menu stays in view, also on right-to-left sites.
  • Fixed: On right-to-left sites, phone and WhatsApp numbers read left to right in widgets, Dynamic Tags and Header & Footer; Start/End alignment icons follow the reading direction, and the button icon motion, the Feature Block arrow, the List Block alignment and the Navigation Menu sub-menu indent follow the site direction.
  • Fixed: Saving the settings no longer stops with an error when a field that holds one value (a web address, an email address, a color or a font) is sent as a list; such a value is saved as empty.
  • Fixed: After you save the settings of an ARN Utilities screen, it opens again on the tab you were on, says “Settings saved.” and shows the warnings of the save, such as a founding date in the wrong form or a Google font that could not be downloaded.
  • Fixed: Undoing a media rename (Restore original in AI Media) no longer fails on Windows servers, and backslashes in media titles and alt text are kept: the original state, the new alt text and the change history are saved with their backslashes.
  • Removed: The AEO / GEO / AIO settings tab and the page-level “E-E-A-T & Evidence” and “AEO / GEO / AIO” tabs; they are part of ARN Smart Vendix (Pro). Free keeps SEO, Schema, sitemaps, social previews and the page readiness score, now built from Search Relevance, Technical Discoverability and Content Experience. Values saved in those fields are kept but no longer used.
  • Removed: The [arnsmesu_answer_summary] and [arnsmesu_sources] shortcodes, which showed a page’s short answer and its source links, now print nothing, so pages that still use them lose that text and list; they keep working in ARN Smart Vendix (Pro).
  • Removed: The wp-config.php constants ARNSMESU_<PROVIDER>_API_KEY and the filters arnsmesu_ai_provider_supports_image and arnsmesu_allow_insecure_ai_endpoint. Use the ARN_FREE_AI_<PROVIDER>_KEY constants, the image confirmation on the Settings → ARN Free AI screen and the arn_free_ai_allow_insecure_endpoint filter; the settings screen warns while an old constant is still defined.
  • Security: AI Media suggestions and media renames are limited to administrators, nonce checks and input sanitizing are stricter, and the admin scripts build their HTML with DOM methods.
  • Security: The guided setup never fills in, shows or publishes the site administrator’s email address as the company email. If Company Data still holds it from the old default and the setup’s email field is left empty, the setup removes it so it is not published; Undo setup brings it back.

short_description: 29 Elementor widgets, company data, a design system, 3,800 icons, SEO, a header and footer builder, WooCommerce tools and review-first AI media.
description:
ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor is the free website foundation of the Vendix ecosystem. It combines essential Elementor widgets with centralized business information and practical tools for search visibility, structured data, icons and media management.

Instead of installing a separate plugin for every small website requirement, Site Utilities provides one focused workspace for the features most Elementor websites need every day.

✨ Everything included in Free

  • Guided Setup for a business, news or store site, with one-click undo.
  • 29 Elementor widgets, including three news widgets for news and magazine pages.
  • Global Company Information, reused anywhere through shortcodes and Elementor Dynamic Tags.
  • Design System with brand colors and body and heading fonts for ARN widgets and layouts, or the whole site; Google fonts are downloaded once and served from the site itself.
  • ARN Smart Icon Manager with 3,800 unique, font-free icons.
  • SEO & Visibility Engine with metadata, a social sharing preview, Schema, XML sitemaps and content readiness analysis.
  • Header & Footer Builder with display rules and live preview; it works with the Vendix theme.
  • AI Media Intelligence with review-first suggestions, through Settings → ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key stored encrypted, model, prices, usage and monthly limits).
  • Smart Features: Search & Replace, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Disable Comments, Site Banner and Quick Menu.
  • WooCommerce Tools: Store Type and Product Identifiers & Cost with tax-aware profit-margin tracking.
  • Responsive, RTL/LTR and accessibility-aware output, with modular loading so optional systems and large icon packs load only when required.
  • No license key and no private updater. Free updates use the normal WordPress repository workflow.

🧭 Guided Setup

ARN Utilities → Setup opens once after the first activation and sets up a site in about five minutes. The Vendix theme’s welcome page leads to it too.

  • Pick Business, News & Magazine or Online Store; the setup turns on the features that kind of site needs. Advanced levels and a fully custom setup are part of Vendix Pro.
  • Choose one of six color palettes and four font pairs (or keep your current colors), fill in your company details once, and optionally add sample pages, a Main menu and a simple header and footer. For an online store, WooCommerce is installed and activated only when you click.
  • Undo setup brings your earlier settings back and moves the pages and layouts the setup made to the Trash. Your posts, products, orders, existing pages and menus are never touched.

🧩 29 Elementor widgets

All widgets appear inside the ARN Smart Site Utilities category in Elementor. New widgets come with a short sample story and drawings, so a page looks finished before you change the text.

  • Headings and text: Advanced Heading, Icon Heading, List Block, Smart Text Editor.
  • Hero and calls to action: Hero Slider, Button, CTA, Counter, Feature Block, Process / Timeline, Pricing Table.
  • People and trust: Testimonials, Team Members, Logo Carousel.
  • Company and contact: Company Information, Contact Cards, Get in Touch, Business Hours.
  • Site parts: Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools, Site Logo, Breadcrumbs.
  • Content and media: Post / Content Grid, FAQ, Responsive Image.
  • News widgets (Smart Features → News Widgets, off by default): Section Header, News Blocks, News Ticker.

The four site widgets — Navigation Menu, Header Search, Header Tools and Site Logo — work in any theme or Elementor layout and do not need the plugin’s own Header & Footer Builder. What each widget does is listed in the FAQ.

🧱 Header & Footer Builder

Build site headers and footers under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer without a page builder template.

  • Rows and columns with logo, menu, mobile menu, search, button, text, contact, social, language, account, cart, wishlist, copyright, image, HTML, spacer and divider elements.
  • Display rules for the whole site, the front page, search results, the 404 page, single content or archives, with exclusions; sticky and transparent headers, a mobile panel and live preview.
  • Works with classic and block themes (also on Elementor Full Width pages), with blank page templates such as Elementor Canvas, and with the Vendix theme’s own header and footer places.
  • Keyboard and screen reader friendly: the mobile panel and the search layer keep the focus inside while open, and Escape closes an open sub-menu.

🏢 Company Information, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags

Enter website, company, contact, legal and social data once under ARN Utilities → Company Data and reuse it everywhere: in Site Utilities widgets, through shortcodes in any WordPress or Elementor content, and through Elementor Dynamic Tags in native Elementor widgets.

Official information is often repeated in privacy policies, terms of use, distance-sales agreements, refund policies, contact pages and footers. With shortcodes, an address, phone number or legal detail is updated in one field instead of on dozens of pages:

[arnsmesu_company_legal_name], registered under [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry], operates from [arnsmesu_company_address]. Contact: [arnsmesu_company_phone].

The full list of fields, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags is in the FAQ.

🎨 ARN Smart Icon Manager

  • 3,800 unique, font-free SVG-mask icons in exactly two sets, Default Icons (1,181) and Interface Essentials (2,994), that inherit the Elementor color and scale cleanly at any size.
  • Category and icon search, a personal My Icons selection, and whole categories when required; large icon styles load by pack instead of the complete library on every page.
  • Disabling a category never breaks icons already saved in Elementor content. Elementor’s own and Font Awesome libraries remain available.

📈 SEO & Visibility Engine

The Visibility Engine is disabled until an administrator enables it. It can work as a complete visibility layer, or keep only its analyzer when another supported SEO plugin controls public metadata.

  • SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, robots, Open Graph and X cards, with a live social sharing preview.
  • Analysis of the content that is actually rendered (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor and shortcodes): headings, images and alt text, links, length and a page language check, with a readiness score and recommendations.
  • Connected JSON-LD Schema and a controlled XML sitemap.

These tools improve content structure and machine understanding; they do not promise rankings or AI citations. The details are in the FAQ.

🤖 AI Media Intelligence

AI Media is optional and disabled by default. It follows a preview-first workflow so an administrator remains in control.

  • Filename, title, slug and alt-text suggestions, previewed before anything is applied, for one item or in batches.
  • Filename changes keep WordPress metadata and content references in sync; every change is recorded and can be restored.
  • Optional alt text for newly uploaded images.

AI requests go through Settings → ARN Free AI, the AI connection shared by ARN Free plugins: WordPress AI (the provider connected under Settings → Connectors on WordPress 7.0+, no API key stored), or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot AI), xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint, with the model you choose. Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

When ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) is active and manages media AI on the site, AI Media leaves media suggestions and automatic alt text to WebPix and shows a link to it instead.

🧰 Smart Features

Site-wide utilities, each turned on or off under ARN Utilities → Smart Features:

  • Admin Notes on the dashboard, personal or shared.
  • Draft Preview Links that expire after 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days and can be revoked.
  • Search & Replace for the database with preview, undo of the last 5 runs, old domain scan and cache purge.
  • Disable Comments site-wide, without ever deleting existing comments.
  • Site Banner, News Widgets and the Quick Menu of admin shortcuts to filtered lists.

🛒 WooCommerce Tools

Available when WooCommerce is active; both tools are optional and disabled by default.

  • Store Type declares the store Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed, and the product editor adjusts to match. Existing products are never changed automatically.
  • Product Identifiers & Cost adds MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP, Manufacturer, Supplier, Cost, Shipping Cost and Other Costs, with live, tax-aware profit-margin tracking. Cost fields are never shown to customers.

⚙️ Settings and data lifecycle

  • Optional modules remain inactive until enabled, and deactivation never deletes settings, authored content or company information.
  • Data is removed only when the administrator enables the uninstall option and then deletes the plugin; Vendix Pro data and Elementor templates are not removed. Multisite-aware.

⭐ Upgrade to ARN Smart Vendix Pro

ARN Smart Vendix is the professional Elementor framework for larger production websites. It includes the complete Free foundation and adds:

  • A much larger widget collection: more hero designs, sliders, carousels, tabs, tickers, countdowns, pricing and comparison tables, modals, hotspots and before/after images, and more layouts and options for the Free widgets.
  • The full newspaper set, the full Design System with the Elementor Kit, and advanced and custom levels in the guided setup.
  • Form Guard, per content-type Disable Comments, a Store Type scan-and-convert tool and other site tools.
  • AEO / GEO / AIO analysis, E-E-A-T evidence checks and the Site Report.
  • ARN Smart license management, private Pro updates and priority support.

Site Utilities remains independently installable and usable without an ARN Smart Vendix Pro license.

Learn more: Explore ARN Smart Vendix

🔗 Other ARN Smart Products

ARN Smart develops focused WordPress products that can be used independently or together:

  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer / ARN Smart WebPix — local image optimization in Free; advanced discovery, coverage, queues, delivery, and diagnostics in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Content Toolkit / ARN Smart Clonex — controlled draft preparation in Free; structured duplication, datasets, bulk production, and builder-aware workflows in Pro.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager / ARN Smart Linkix — short links, redirects, QR codes, and local analytics in Free; custom permalinks, Smart App Links, branded QR, analytics, and maintenance in Pro.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent / ARN Smart Visioix — visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics, and contact actions in Free; connected visitor and website intelligence in Pro.

Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

AI Media (ARN Free AI). This plugin does not contact any ARN server. AI features are off until a site administrator sets them up under Settings > ARN Free AI.

When an administrator chooses a provider and enters their own API key, the plugin sends the text (and, for media features, the selected image) needed for the requested task to that provider only, at the moment the task runs. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

Requests are sent only while Media Intelligence is enabled: when an administrator clicks AI Preview or Generate Selected Previews, or when automatic alt text (off by default) runs for a newly uploaded image. Sent data: the image (a copy of at most 4 MB, preferably a smaller size made by WordPress; SVG files are not sent) and its context: site name and tagline, file name, file type, title, slug, current alt text, caption, a short description, the parent post title, the titles and short excerpts of up to three posts that use the file, and the site language. The “Test connection” (a fixed test prompt, no site content) and “Load models” (the provider’s model list) buttons under Settings > ARN Free AI also contact the chosen provider when an administrator clicks them. Nothing is sent while AI is not set up, or while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI on the site.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, requests go through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

The bundled ARN Free AI module keeps its settings in the arn_free_ai_settings option and daily AI usage totals (no prompts, answers or keys) in the {prefix}arn_free_ai_usage database table.

Design System Google fonts. Only when an administrator chooses a Google font as the body or heading font under ARN Utilities > Design System and saves: the site’s server downloads that font once, the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and the WOFF2 font files it lists from fonts.gstatic.com (Latin, Latin Extended and Arabic, the weights the Design System uses). The request carries the font family and weights only; no visitor or site data is sent. The files are stored in wp-content/uploads/arnsmesu-fonts and served from the site itself, so visitors’ browsers never connect to Google. The font list comes from Elementor.

  • Google Fonts: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

Search & Replace. Only when an administrator uses these tools:

  • “Find old addresses” sends an HTTP HEAD request to at most 5 earlier site addresses found in the database, using one sample file address on each, to see whether the old address still answers. No site data is sent.
  • After a run or an undo, the plugin requests the site’s own home page once to detect a server or CDN page cache.

Guided Setup. Only when an administrator clicks “Install & activate” on the setup’s Plugins step of an online store: WordPress’s own plugin installer asks WordPress.org for WooCommerce’s download address and downloads it from there, as it does under Plugins → Add New. No other setup step uses an external service.

  • WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

The Header & Footer Builder, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links and Social Sharing Preview do not use external services.

If you use a page cache or CDN, clear it after updating: Elementor regenerates its CSS, and cached pages may look unstyled or show empty icons.
